Estimated 2003 fuel consumption ~99M gal. Fair value not separately disclosed. Item8_notes notes $1.5M reclassified from OCI to income in 2002 as offset to fuel expense.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel and oil and associated taxes decreased $8.3 million, or 9.5%, in 2002. Into-plane fuel prices decreased 8.9% per gallon, averaging 83.4¢ per gallon in 2002 versus 91.5¢ per gallon in 2001. Fuel consumption decreased 0.7% in 2002. [Derived: 2003 fuel = $81.1M increased $2.4M from 2002; 2002 = $78.7M / $0.834 = 94.4M gallons]
